name: Counsellor
overview: The title 'Counsellor' in Scripture denotes a person of wisdom and authority, exemplified by figures such as Ahithophel, who served as King David's adviser, and Joseph of Arimathaea, an honorable member of the Sanhedrin who awaited God's kingdom. This role involved both legal and diplomatic expertise, as seen in 1 Chronicles where counsellors are described as wise men and scribes. Ultimately, 'Counsellor' is also a Messianic title given to Christ, highlighting His divine wisdom and guidance as prophesied in Isaiah, where He is called Wonderful Counsellor, emphasizing His eternal and mighty nature.
